audit_expectations.mode: Empty HTML shell (SPA that never hydrates for machines)
audit_expectations.notes: The raw response is a bare #root mount with one module script and no content, and no headless renderer is available. A no-JS machine reads a contentless, unorientable page. NOTE: render.empty_initial_shell is intentionally NOT expected here — without a rendered DOM the render skill correctly degrades to a logged limitation rather than guessing, so the surviving true signal is the engagement/orientation failure.
